authentication_method.description: The authentication method to use. Can be either `OAUTH` or `PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`.

personal_access_token.description: Your Asana `Personal Access Token`. Required if `authenticationMethod` is set to `PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`.

projects.description: Specific Project IDs to sync. Must be populated if `syncMode` is set to `SpecificProjects`.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all projects or specific projects.

schema.title: Destination schema name
schema.description: Destination schema name. Schema name is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Asana client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Asana client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
